significance.justification: Verified true, the claim would establish that a "same-base reference model" detects otherwise neutral trait payloads and that "detection AUC falls in tandem with transmission strength" as reference divergence increases; this is form (iii), a predictive coupling between independently measurable detection, divergence, and transmission quantities, plus a causal shared-geometry account. It establishes both a consequential phenomenon—kin-specific detectability—and partial mechanism, fixing expectations for detector performance at intermediate base-model divergence; this directly addresses the shared-initialization dependence and failed human/LLM detection reported in the 2025 Subliminal Learning work rather than merely showing another encoded trait. A verified-false result would meaningfully show that shared initialization's role in transmission is not generally invertible into detection, although the claim's two proposed detector classes make partial failure less decisive; true and false nevertheless describe distinguishable AUC and coupling outcomes. After topic substitution, subliminal learning alone would not earn this score: the specific detection–transmission coupling and divergence law, which are false of the topic-median trait-transfer hypothesis, provide the increment.

reach.justification: The named handle is a "practical auditor built from a same-base reference model," instantiated as a gradient-alignment score or activation probe that flags candidate distillation corpora and identifies the transmitted trait. It is ex ante because it can screen a corpus before that corpus is used for student training, giving synthetic-data and model-deployment practitioners an action window rather than merely explaining an observed failure. After re-extraction on another model, the claimed "graceful degradation law" predicts that detection will decline with reference divergence in tandem with transmission, so more than a lookup direction survives recalibration, although no precise functional form is asserted and access to the relevant base limits unknown-provenance use. The asserted scope covers multiple traits, misalignment, and distillation pipelines, with auditors and pipeline operators downstream; topic substitution would remove both this usable screen and its transferable coupling, so the reach score is attributable to the claim rather than to subliminal learning generally.
